subject.title: fix(web): mark partial response reads when streams fail

question: Should this PR require a redacted live interrupted-response proof, or is the maintainer's deterministic Web Streams/Testbox proof enough to override the external-PR real-behavior proof gate?
rationale: External-contributor PR policy treats unit-style and mocked tests as supplemental, but a maintainer has already supplied targeted Testbox proof and stated the standards-defined failure path is covered; automation should not infer override intent from that tension.

options.title: Accept deterministic proof as override
options.body: Treat the maintainer Testbox run plus Web Streams contract as sufficient for this low-blast-radius stream-error fix and proceed through exact-head merge guards.

options.title: Require live reset proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate active until the PR body or a comment includes redacted terminal/log/live output from an interrupted web_fetch or provider-backed response.

options.title: Pause until CI settles
options.body: Hold the PR open without repair work while exact-head checks and proof policy are resolved by a maintainer.

recommendation.title: Accept deterministic proof as override
recommendation.body: Treat the maintainer Testbox run plus Web Streams contract as sufficient for this low-blast-radius stream-error fix and proceed through exact-head merge guards.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, and his maintainer fixup/comment already frames the proof gap and land-ready judgment.
